input: Create a shared family calendar everyone can edit

gold.taskTitle: Build a shared editable family calendar
gold.taskDescription: Set up a shared calendar that all family members can access and edit together.

questions.title: Which platform do you want to use for this?
questions.description: Identify the preferred calendar platform, such as Google Calendar, Apple Calendar, Outlook, or a physical option.

questions.title: How many family members need access to it?
questions.description: Determine the total number of people who will be sharing and editing the calendar.

questions.title: What devices do your family members primarily use?
questions.description: Find out whether family members use iPhones, Android phones, computers, or a mix, to ensure compatibility.

questions.title: Do all family members have an existing account to share with?
questions.description: Check whether everyone has a Google, Apple, or Microsoft account, or if new accounts need to be created.

questions.title: What types of events do you most need to track?
questions.description: Understand the main use cases, such as school schedules, appointments, holidays, or chores.

questions.title: Should everyone have full edit rights or just some members?
questions.description: Clarify whether all members can add and change events, or if certain people should only view the calendar.

questions.title: Do you want event reminders or notifications turned on?
questions.description: Determine whether family members should receive alerts for upcoming events and, if so, how far in advance.
